accessibility.text: If RP-onset is an unconscious decision, does that limit our free will?
is free will an important good?

There is wide experimental confirmation of the fact that the sort of increased brain activity which occurs at RP-onset is correlated with actions. But that does not mean that it is an unconscious decision. Perhaps, for instance, RP-onset is a process which sometimes leads to a decision, rather than the decision itself. Maybe it just shows that the action is being considered, or imagined.
